sections.title: Geo-Economics: Strategies for an Era of Great Power Rivalry and Political Polarization
sections.description: Corporate and financial leaders, as well as governments, must navigate complex economic and geopolitical dynamics in an interconnected and increasingly volatile global landscape. This course explores some of the key strategic issues impacting business operations and investment strategies in the context of reverse-globalization, protectionism, inflation, deficits and debt, and geopolitical competition.
